title: thymus serpyllum f. danubialis
intro: Thymus serpyllum f. danubialis, commonly known as Danube thyme, is a subspecies of the thyme plant, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to act as an antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, which can help to soothe digestive issues, boost the immune system, and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Danube thyme include its antiseptic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Danube thyme include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies and traditional medicine.
